scenes.title: Tokens: Breaking Text Apart
scenes.narration: Transformers first split text into tokens—small pieces like words or word parts—so the model can process language as numbers.

scenes.title: Self-Attention: Finding Connections
scenes.narration: Self-attention lets each token compare with every other token, deciding which relationships matter most for understanding meaning and context in a sentence.

scenes.title: Layers: Producing Predictions
scenes.narration: Stacked transformer layers repeatedly refine these representations, then predict useful outputs, such as the next token, a translation, or an answer.
